paragraphs: Mar Zutra son of Rav Nachman: Berakhot 43b; Shabbat 88b, 96a; Beitzah 34b; Bava Metzia 4b; Zevachim 9a. In Rav Nachman’s name: Gittin 50a; Bava Batra 151b. He said to Rav Huna son of Rav Nachman: Bekhorot 54b. Rav Huna bar Chinena and Rav Safra: Moed Katan 12a. He came before Rav Yosef: Sanhedrin 5a. Rava and Rav Safra met him: Chullin 94b.
